text: Since I came out as non-binary, which the experience helped me do, I've had a lot of stressful situations with my family and at work. I handle them better because I'm not fighting myself anymore. The stress comes from outside now, not from inside, and that's much easier to deal with.
Ich lasse mich nicht mehr so schnell aus der Ruhe bringen, auch wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig schiefgehen.

I moved to a new country for work a year after the experience, alone, without speaking the language. It was really hard. But I kept remembering something from the trip, a feeling that I am at home in myself wherever I am. That helped me when I felt lonely or lost. I also made more effort to meet people than I would have before.
I don't really know. Maybe a bit more patient

Wenn ich heute in eine stressige Situation komme, merke ich schneller, dass ich wieder in mein altes Muster falle: Ich will alles allein lösen und lasse niemanden helfen. Das habe ich in der Erfahrung sehr deutlich gesehen. Jetzt versuche ich, früher um Unterstützung zu bitten, z.B. bei meinem Mann oder meiner Schwester.

The experience was in a ceremony with a small group and a facilitator who had us set intentions beforehand. Mine was to learn how to deal with my work stress, I'm a lawyer and I was close to burnout. What came up during the ceremony was not what I expected, it was mostly memories of my grandfather, who was a farmer and always said that you can't hurry a harvest. I cried a lot thinking of him. Since then, when I feel the pressure at work, I think of him and his patience. It sounds a bit silly but it really works for me. I also took a few weeks off, and I've reduced my hours, which my firm wasn't happy about.
I handle stress about the same as before, nothing really changed there.
Seitdem habe ich bei Stress eher das Gefühl, dass das schon irgendwie gut geht. Ich vertraue mehr darauf, dass ich Lösungen finde, und gerate nicht mehr so schnell in Panik.

It helped me to stop running away from problems. I used to quit jobs, end relationships, move cities whenever things got hard. Now I try to stay and face what's going on. I lasted 2 years in my current job, which is a record for me lol
Better at taking a step back when stressed

Ich bin nach der Erfahrung viel achtsamer geworden. Ich meditiere morgens, mache abends einen Spaziergang und achte darauf, wie es mir geht. Wenn ich merke, dass der Stress zu viel wird, nehme ich mir bewusst eine Pause. Das hätte ich früher nie gemacht, da habe ich einfach weitergemacht, bis ich krank wurde. Ich glaube, die Erfahrung hat mir gezeigt, dass ich gut für mich sorgen darf.

I'm less afraid of conflict. I used to avoid it at all costs, but now I can have a difficult conversation with my boss or my roommate without my heart pounding for hours. I think the experience made me feel more solid in myself.

My experience was not positive. It was a very dark trip where I felt trapped and saw my own death over and over. Afterwards I had several months of anxiety and insomnia, and any stressful event would make it worse. I lost my job during that time because I couldn't concentrate. With time and therapy things got better, and I would say I'm now about where I was before, but those months were the hardest of my life.
Durch die Erfahrung sehe ich vieles relativer. Stress im Job oder Streit mit Freunden fühlt sich nicht mehr so existenziell an, weil ich weiß, dass es Wichtigeres gibt.

I used to have terrible exam anxiety, like throwing up before every exam. After the experience I can calm myself down with breathing, and I remind myself that one exam doesn't decide my life. Passed all my finals this year without panicking.
i dont let things build up as much. i talk about stuff earlier and dont wait till i explode

Ich habe in der Erfahrung sehr viel über mich gelernt, vor allem darüber, wie ich mit Druck umgehe. Ich habe gesehen, dass ich mich unter Stress sofort klein mache und mich für alles verantwortlich fühle, was schiefläuft. Ich habe verstanden, dass das von meiner Mutter kommt, die mir als Kind immer die Schuld gegeben hat, wenn sie schlechte Laune hatte. Dieses Wissen hilft mir jetzt, in schwierigen Situationen innezuhalten und mich zu fragen, ob ich wirklich schuld bin oder ob ich wieder das alte Muster abspule. Meistens ist es das alte Muster. Ich habe dadurch gelernt, mich besser abzugrenzen, sowohl im Job als auch in meiner Familie. Ich komme mit belastenden Ereignissen heute deutlich besser zurecht als früher, auch wenn es noch nicht immer klappt.
I'm more grounded. When something stressful happens I can feel my feet on the floor and I don't get carried away by panic so much.

I learned to see my stress as information rather than a threat. When I feel stressed now, I ask myself what it's telling me: am I overloaded, am I avoiding something, am I scared of disappointing someone? That's made a big difference in how I react, and I've made some real changes in my life based on the answers, like dropping a volunteer role I didn't actually want.
Kein Unterschied zu vorher

Since the experience I have been a lot more accepting of the stressful situations that I can't change, for example my mother's illness and my financial worries. I can feel the worry without being consumed by it. I think the experience taught me that feelings come and go, and that I don't have to hold on to them or push them away. Life is less of a battle now.

I've become quite a lot calmer under stress. Small things that used to make me furious, like my kids making a mess or someone cutting me off in traffic, I can let go of now. With bigger things, I still get stressed but I recover faster. My wife says I'm a much nicer person to be around.
Belastende Ereignisse kann ich besser annehmen und muss nicht mehr so viel dagegen ankämpfen.
I don't think it changed how I deal with stress. If anything I'm a bit more sensitive.

The experience made me realise that I've been using alcohol to cope with stress for years. During the trip I saw myself drinking alone in my kitchen every night and it shocked me. I stopped drinking a week later and I've been sober for 14 months. Now when I'm stressed I go to the gym, call my sponsor, or go to a meeting. It's not easy, but I deal with things head on now instead of numbing them. I also understand that the drinking was covering a lot of anxiety that I'm now learning to face.
Ich bin gelassener geworden, vor allem im Umgang mit meinen Kindern, die gerade in der Pubertät sind.
More able to see the funny side of things when they go wrong. I laugh at myself more.

Stressful events feel smaller. During the experience I saw the earth from far away, like an astronaut, and I felt how small all our human dramas are. That image comes back to me when I'm stressed and it helps me breathe. I know it sounds clichéd, but it really has stuck with me for years now.

Ich kann mit Stress inzwischen deutlich besser umgehen, weil ich gelernt habe, auf meinen Körper zu hören. Wenn ich merke, dass ich angespannt bin, mache ich eine kurze Pause, atme durch oder gehe ein paar Minuten an die frische Luft. Früher habe ich das ignoriert und hatte dann ständig Kopfschmerzen.
Not much change. I was already pretty good at handling stress.

I've been through a lot of stressful events since the experience: a divorce, a job loss, my dad's heart attack. I think what helped most is that I don't take it all so personally anymore. During the experience, I felt that life is not happening to me, it's just happening, and I'm part of it. That shift from 'why me' to 'this is life' has made a huge difference. I still get sad and scared, but I don't feel like a victim. I also reached out more, I let my friends help me move, I talked to my sister about dad. And I've learned to give myself small breaks, a walk, a coffee with a friend, a good book, to recharge.
Ich denke heute in stressigen Situationen mehr darüber nach, was mir wirklich wichtig ist, und lasse mich von Kleinigkeiten nicht mehr so beeindrucken. Ich habe gelernt, Prioritäten zu setzen.
It's helped me deal with my social anxiety in stressful social situations, like presentations or parties. I'm still nervous, but I don't avoid them anymore.
I got better at recognising my emotions under stress. Before I would just feel 'bad', now I can tell if it's fear, sadness, anger or shame, and that helps me know what to do.

Die Erfahrung war für mich vor allem eine spirituelle. Ich habe das Gefühl bekommen, dass ich getragen werde, egal was passiert. Wenn heute etwas Belastendes geschieht, z.B. Krankheit in der Familie oder Probleme im Job, dann erinnere ich mich an dieses Gefühl und kann mich etwas entspannen. Das ist nicht immer einfach, und manchmal vergesse ich es auch, aber es ist wie ein Anker für mich.
I am less anxious about the future, so things that might go wrong don't stress me out as much as they used to.

I've become better at dealing with my anxiety around flying, which is the biggest stressful event in my life since I travel a lot for work. During the experience, I faced an intense fear of dying, and when I let go, there was peace. I think of that when the plane takes off.
Ich fühle mich in stressigen Situationen nicht mehr so allein. Ich habe gemerkt, dass ich mir Hilfe holen kann, und mache das jetzt auch.

I'm a single mum of three and stress is basically my life. The experience didn't change my circumstances but it changed my attitude a lot. I stopped trying to be the perfect mum and I let things be messy. I laugh more with my kids, and when it's chaos I just breathe and remind myself that this phase won't last forever. I also started asking my neighbour for help sometimes, which I was too proud to do before.
I handle stress better in general, though I'm not sure if that's because of the experience or just getting older.
